invariants.observation: ingest calls temporal.observe(event) before it returns decide_at(...) for a decision-kind event.
invariants.consequence: A decision event that references an action is already in the temporal trace when evaluate runs.

invariants.invariant: The only temporal-engine error path is 'no event observed'
invariants.observation: The function returns Err only when the partition last/trace is missing or the trace length is zero (ok_or("no event observed")). All leaf computation uses eval_condition, which is total.
invariants.consequence: For an observed decision event the error path is structurally unreachable.

invariants.observation: Signature returns bool; all branches return bool; no Result/error channel.
invariants.consequence: A temporal leaf cannot raise a runtime evaluation error in this engine.

invariants.observation: A recursive grep for 'formerly' returns no matches.
invariants.consequence: Temporal evaluation is entirely in the Dogwood layer; Cedar cannot produce a temporal-engine failure.
